e2ee.approvalNote: New devices must be explicitly approved. Revoking a device removes its ability to receive future encrypted messages from this account.
e2ee.tofu: Echo uses trust-on-first-use: the first time you message someone, your clients learn each other’s keys automatically. Compare this fingerprint with your contact in person or over a trusted channel if you want stronger assurance.
e2ee.fingerprintChange: If your contact reinstalls Echo or registers a new device, their fingerprint may change — treat that like a new key.
